assignment.assignmentRationale: Highest explicit policy priority, then lexical profile ID.

forbiddenActions: Do not invoke Git or an integration adapter, mutate a repository, create arbitrary graph operations, store inverse edges, or claim verification/system/business outcomes.
Do not weaken, rewrite, or silently migrate prior vocabulary profiles; compatible additions must be a new explicit version.
Do not modify non-allowlisted files or create commits, tags, pull requests, or merges.

bootstrapDisposition.authority: The task may propose only the trusted contributor, compatible versioned vocabulary additions, exports, and isolated tests. Core retains graph validation/merge, WorkItemVerification, integration, progression, SystemVerification, and BusinessAcceptance authority.
bootstrapDisposition.reason: ChangeIntegration is being built, so the visible task host temporarily performs the released WorkExecution executor-port role.

successBoundary: Require exact loaded canonical bytes and ArtifactRefs for ModuleResult, IntegratedChangeRecord, VerifiedWorkItemSubject, WorkItem/ChangeSet, and referenced baselines.
Require ModuleResult outcome integrated and output refs exactly equal the loaded IntegratedChangeRecord and post RepositorySnapshot.
Derive only controlled node/edge kinds from validated domain references; accept no adapter-supplied nodes, relationships, or graph operations.
Resolve every architecture and contract reference against exact loaded approved baselines; unknown, stale, cross-item, or substituted references fail closed.

Use TraceabilityGraph Core to validate and atomically merge the projection; prove exact replay is idempotent and the merge receipt binds prior graph version, update digest, execution ID, and resulting checkpoint.
designConstraint.summary: Project factual, upstream-to-downstream integration lineage only from one exact validated integrated ModuleResult and persisted IntegratedChangeRecord; the contributor proposes a deterministic projection and never mutates the graph.
designConstraint.vocabularyBoundary: Add a backward-compatible traceability vocabulary/profile version only where current endpoint rules cannot express the approved factual edges. Preserve exact validation and replay of every prior 1.0-1.3 profile; do not reinterpret historical graphs.

incomingEdges.rationale: Factual edges derive only from one validated IntegratedChangeRecord.

requiredCorrections: Validate the loaded ModuleResult through documentValidators.moduleResult, then enforce the exact ChangeIntegration integrated outcome contract: status completed; exactly integrated-change-record and repository-snapshot output ports with one full persisted ArtifactRef each; required native-effect and post-state pass evidence bound to those outputs; no extra outputs or downstream authority fields.

Replace first-match loaded reference lookup with exact-one resolution for WorkItem, ChangeSet, architecture baseline, and contract disposition. Reject zero or multiple matches, partial/full-reference substitution, and noncanonical loaded bytes.

Strengthen tests with schema-invalid, extra-output, extra downstream claim, duplicate exact-reference, and canonical stale-reference cases. Do not rely only on mutating value without recomputing its loaded bytes/ref.

Assert the atomic merge proof explicitly: starting graph version/checkpoint, update digest, execution identity, resulting graph version/checkpoint, merged disposition, and exact replay with no new graph changes. Assert all four edge directions and reject inverse forms under the 1.4 profile.
Preserve exact 1.0-1.3 vocabulary identities and the bounded forward-only 1.4 contributor introduced in attempt 001.
stopConditions: Stop with clarify only if the approved four factual relationships cannot be expressed through a compatible new vocabulary profile without altering historical semantics.
Stop with block if exact context or required verification dependencies are unavailable.
Stop after the bounded handoff; do not begin module-level verification.
Stop with fix if a non-integrated, substituted, adapter-authored, inverse, verification, system, or business fact can merge.

verification.acceptance: Only exact validated integrated bytes yield the four forward factual relationships and an atomic replayable merge proof; non-integrated, substituted, stale, arbitrary, inverse, verification, system, or business facts fail closed, while all prior vocabulary fixtures remain valid.

requiredEvidence.description: Integrated-change lineage is reproducible and factual edges exist only after exact validated integration success.

excluded: Adapter-authored graph operations, inverse edges, premature integration facts, acceptance-criterion verified-by facts, SystemVerification, or BusinessAcceptance.
included: Link WorkItem and ChangeSet to IntegratedChangeRecord after validated success.
Link affected architecture and contracts to the resulting change with atomic merge proof.

deliverables.description: Integrated-change traceability contributor and merge proof.

dependency-hints.rationale: Factual edges derive only from one validated IntegratedChangeRecord.

workItem.objective: Derive forward-only factual integrated-change relationships through a trusted contributor.

required-evidence.description: Integrated-change lineage is reproducible and factual edges exist only after exact validated integration success.

checks.method: Derive, validate, atomically merge, replay, and query allowed forward edges while rejecting arbitrary, inverse, premature, verification, system, and business edges.
